items: [Normalisation] ASCII letters are lower-cased and kept
[Normalisation] every maximal run of other characters (including non-ASCII) becomes exactly one `-`
[Normalisation] no leading or trailing `-`; input with no ASCII alphanumerics gives the empty string
[Truncation] a slug of at most `max` bytes is returned unchanged
[Truncation] a longer slug is cut to the longest prefix of whole words of length at most `max`
[Truncation] the truncated result never ends with `-`
[Truncation] a first word longer than `max` is hard-cut to `max` bytes
